title: Java Developer ( AWS & IAM experience)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Senior Software Engineer — Identity & Customer Platform (CIAM)**
**Experience:**
3–5 years | Stack: Java 21
  
  

* Spring Boot
* Keycloak
* AWS
* React/TypeScript

**About The Role**
You'll build and operate the services behind our Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) platform — authentication, authorisation, user account management, and the migration of legacy identity systems onto Keycloak. This is a polyglot, multi-repo environment: most of the weight is backend Java, with meaningful frontend and infrastructure work alongside it.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Design and ship backend services in Java 21 / Spring Boot (REST via Spring MVC, Jersey/JAX-RS, and Spring Cloud Gateway on WebFlux)
* Extend Keycloak 26 through custom SPIs, authentication flows, and themes; contribute to realm configuration managed as code
* Build event-driven and data-backed features on AWS — SQS/SNS, S3, Secrets Manager — with PostgreSQL and Liquibase schema migrations
* Drive the strangler-pattern migration of legacy identity services with zero-downtime cutovers
* Design API contracts first (OpenAPI/springdoc, generated clients, contract diffing in CI) and keep them backward compatible
* Write meaningful tests at every level: JUnit 5, AssertJ, Mockito, ArchUnit, Testcontainers (Postgres + LocalStack), WireMock, REST Assured
* Own your services in production: Datadog APM/RUM, Micrometer/OpenTelemetry, structured JSON logging, and on-call participation
* Ship through GitHub Actions pipelines with SonarQube quality gates, JaCoCo coverage, CycloneDX SBOMs, and strict Gradle dependency locking
* Review peers' code and participate in architecture decisions — not just implement tickets

Must have (4–5 years)
  
  

* 4+ years of professional JVM development, with recent work on Java 17/21 and Spring Boot
* Solid grasp of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, and SAML — you can explain authorization code + PKCE, token exchange, and refresh token rotation without looking them up
* Hands-on relational database work: schema design, indexing, query tuning, and versioned migrations (Liquibase or Flyway)
* Practical AWS experience running production workloads (messaging, storage, secrets, IAM)
* Docker and container-based local development; comfort with Docker Compose and Testcontainers
* Strong automated testing discipline — you treat tests as part of the deliverable, not an afterthought
* Git-based trunk/feature-branch workflow, CI/CD pipelines, and code review as a daily habit
* Clear written communication in English; ability to document decisions and trade-offs

Strongly preferred
  
  

* Direct Keycloak experience (custom providers, SPIs, admin client, theming) or comparable IdP work (Auth0, Gigya, Okta, ForgeRock)
* Gradle (Kotlin DSL) in a multi-module / platform-BOM setup
* React 18 + TypeScript with Vite — enough to own a full vertical slice through the UI
* Node.js/Express services in TypeScript
* Kubernetes and Helm; Terraform for infrastructure and IdP configuration as code
* Observability practice: dashboards, SLOs, alerting, and debugging distributed traces
* Experience in a regulated environment (healthcare/life sciences, GxP, HIPAA/GDPR) — data privacy is a first-class concern here

Nice to have
  
  

* Python (tooling/automation), Ruff/pytest
* Playwright or Cypress end-to-end testing; visual regression testing
* Performance/load testing (k6, JMeter)
* Application security background: OWASP Top 10, SAST/DAST, dependency and SBOM hygiene

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Java Software Engineer - Connectors - Remote
description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently.

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally.

**Job Description**

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers’ systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations.

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists.

Key team values:

* Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
* Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
* Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
* Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay ahead

About the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

* Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365.
* Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi-tenant SaaS environments.
* Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven).
* Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.
* Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.
* Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.
* Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.
* Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.

You will be successful in this role if you:

* Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture.
* Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives.
* Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers.
* Are able to make data-driven decisions.
* Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from.
* Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push.

**Qualifications**

We are looking for:

* 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements.
* 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants.
* Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems.
* Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns.
* Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e).

Technical Skills and Experience:

* Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc.).
* Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling).

title: Full-Stack Engineer — Systems Conductor
description:
About Bold Business

Bold Business is an AI-first, delivery-first company building production-grade enterprise software, automation engines, and autonomous agent infrastructure. We build the way modern teams build: our engineers are not syntax-typists but Systems Conductors, who leverage advanced AI-agent developer environments to design, build, test, and ship production software at multiples of traditional manual velocity.

The Role

We're hiring
****Full-Stack Systems Conductors****

to own feature delivery across our flagship TechForce platform — spanning React/TypeScript frontends, Python/FastAPI backends, and robust PostgreSQL data schemas.

You'll own high-impact modules from day one, but your true value lies in your ability to design robust databases, orchestrate complex systems, and lead background coding agents through rigorous, test-driven implementations.

****Two principles define how we work, and we hire for both explicitly:****

****AI-Agentic Command.****

AI coding environments (Cursor, Claude Code CLI, OpenClaw / Hermes Agents / Grokbot / other personal agent harnesses, and custom Model Context Protocol servers) are our native workspace, not a novelty. We expect you to command agents to write boilerplate, scaffold routes, and draft test suites. You provide the system architecture, the security guardrails, and the rigorous critical review. Speed from agents, judgment from you.

****Collaborative by Default.****

Every change is strictly peer-reviewed through pull requests. Documentation and automated unit tests ship in the same PR as the code. Blockers get raised early, not discovered at review. We value highly legible, standardized architectures that outlive their author's immediate attention — brilliant work that only its author understands is a liability here, not an asset.

What You'll Do

* ****Architect schema-first features:****

  design strict API boundaries, typed contracts, and database schemas first, providing the structure background AI agents need to implement features safely
* ****Build and secure module workflows:****

  own recruiter and admin interfaces (screens, tables, profiles, forms, filters, dashboards), REST endpoints, and PostgreSQL relational workflows — with business security and authorization policies strictly enforced at the data layer
* ****Establish codebase context:****

  build and use MCP servers and AST-based dependency graphs to give developer agents standardized, structured access to our repositories
* ****Orchestrate quality loops:****

  set up local testing environments and containerized CI/CD checks where background agents automatically execute test runs, linting, and type validation before any merge
* ****Engage directly with stakeholders:****

  sit with non-technical stakeholders to translate messy operational processes into clean, executable technical requirements — and keep them in the loop as the work progresses
* ****Stabilize and maintain the platform:****

  production defects, small-to-medium gaps, and reporting migration support as Power BI is retired
* ****Review and be reviewed:****

  give and receive pull-request review as a normal working rhythm, with test evidence on every ticket

Non-Negotiables

We'll ask you to demonstrate all of the following — come ready with real examples:

1. ****Active agentic developer loop.****

   You've transitioned beyond copy-pasting code blocks from a browser window. You can walk us through your CLI-native agentic loop: how you coordinate agents, what parameters and guardrails you set, and — specifically — a time you caught and patched an LLM hallucination before it shipped. "I've tried Copilot" is not this.
2. ****Collaboration you can prove.****

   A working history of PR reviews given and received, documentation you wrote that someone else actually used, and a time you escalated a blocker early instead of grinding on it alone. We will check for this specifically.
3. ****Full-stack competency, production-grade.****

   Strong React/TypeScript and Python/FastAPI experience on real systems in real use — not tutorials or side scripts.
4. ****Database schema and security mastery.****

   Highly fluent in PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, transactional isolation. You understand why hiding a button in React is not an authorization control; authorization is enforced in the data layer.
5. ****Clean systems architecture.****

   You build robust, decoupled state machines (FastAPI, React state, background queues) that gracefully isolate, log, and recover from real-world API and network failures.
6. ****Enterprise systems awareness.****

   You've designed, maintained, or operated within ERP-class platforms (SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, or comparable) — or can clearly demonstrate how they work and why they matter: integrated data, standardized process, and a single operational source of truth. You'll help build a platform that plays exactly this role, so you need to understand what it replaces and what it must not break.
7. ****True Agile and continuous improvement.****

   Not standup theater — iterative delivery, working software shipped in small increments, retrospectives that actually change how the team works. Come ready to describe a real process improvement you drove based on what a sprint or a failure taught you.
8. ****End-to-end micro-project ownership.****

   You'll run micro-projects through their full lifecycle: planning and requirements gathering with stakeholders, implementation, testing, and maintenance afterward — documenting your work and processes clearly enough that another team member can be trained to support and back up what you built without you in the room. Come ready to walk us through one project you carried from first conversation to steady-state maintenance.
9. ****Strong English communication, written and spoken.****

   You'll operate in a U.S.-based team environment and explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Hands-on experience with OpenClaw, Hermes Agents, or Grokbot agent platforms
* Familiarity with LangGraph or stateful multi-agent orchestration
* Operations-heavy SaaS experience (recruiting, workforce management, ATS, or CRM)
* Multi-tenant application experience
* AWS exposure (EC2, RDS, S3, cloud logs)
* Data imports, deduplication, search/filter interfaces, operational reporting
* Experience joining a codebase mid-flight and getting productive fast

What This Role Is

* A hands-on builder-conductor role with defined module ownership
* AI-accelerated delivery with human judgment on every merge
* A high-performing team operating model: review, documentation, and early communication are the job, not overhead

What This Role Is Not

* Not a solo-operator role — if your best work happens when nobody sees it until it's done, this will be a bad fit
* Not an ML research role
* Not a role where AI tools are optional

Compensation & Logistics

****Compensation based on experience.****

Standard options package per company policy.

****Target start:****

Immediately

Final Note

We will go deep into your past work — what you built, why you built it that way, what broke, and who else could run it after you. The engineers who thrive here are the ones whose systems outlive their attention: documented, reviewed, and understood by the team.

****Bold Business — AI-First. Delivery-First. Team-First.****

description:

We need a data enthusiast who pairs sharp analytical capabilities with the leverage of modern AI tools. ****Requirements****

* ****4+ years****

  of hands-on experience in data and analytics, featuring heavy data-modeling responsibilities.

  (schema design, normalization trade-offs, database migrations, query performance tuning).

  for data exploration, auditing, reconciliation, and cross-database validation.

  for developing transformation scripts and data pipelines.

* Proactive adoption of AI tools to accelerate pipeline creation, audit data quality, and enrich datasets.

****Strong Preferences****

  ****ERP, HRIS, WFM, or CRM platforms****

  requirements.

regularised linear models, LightGBM panel models with conformal calibration, and a pre-trained challenger

● Own walk-forward backtesting, the sealed lockbox, prediction intervals, abstention rules and the router that picks an arm per market segment; hierarchical reconciliation from lane to corridor to index.

● Run the pre-registered signal-validation loop: screening of economic hypotheses, multiple-testing (false-

discovery-rate) control, bootstrap and placebo confirmation, and the out-of-sample gate that decides whether a signal enters the models.

● Graph: evaluate graph features through the same backtest fabric as every other feature; specify what the graph layer must deliver for forecasting; keep the door open for graph neural networks once the gates are met.

**Must have**

● Time-series, panel and multi-horizon forecasting in production (not only notebooks); LightGBM and regularised regression; temporal feature engineering.

● Rigorous evaluation: walk-forward and temporal cross-validation, leakage detection, point-in-time (as-of) correctness, calibration, conformal prediction, prediction intervals, model comparison.

● Statistics for signal discovery: lead/lag analysis, Granger-type tests, multiple testing and false-discovery-rate control, bootstrap methods.

● Strong Python, SQL, Pandas/Polars, experiment tracking (MLflow or comparable); containers, APIs and cloud basics.

● Can instruct a coding agent to implement a new forecasting arm with backtests, leakage checks and baseline comparison — and then judge whether the result is statistically correct.

**Nice to have**

Hierarchical forecasting and reconciliation; foundation models for time series; graph machine learning (PyTorch Geometric, heterogeneous graph models); basic Cypher; exposure to logistics, freight, commodities or financial time series.

**About the role**

This is an end-to-end ownership role. The
**Senior Business Analyst**
(BSA) is accountable for the business-facing thread of an automation or AI initiative from first stakeholder conversation to post-production stabilisation. You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Lead structured discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, job shadowing and process walkthroughs with business SMEs to capture the true operating process, including exceptions, workarounds and undocumented tribal knowledge.

* Perform automation feasibility and complexity assessment; qualify or disqualify candidate processes against standardisation, rule-clarity, volume, stability and data-quality criteria, and have the confidence to recommend against automation where the business case does not hold.

* Build the business case: quantify AS-IS effort, volumes, FTE cost, error rates and cycle times; model expected benefit, ROI, payback period and effort estimate, and present it to client sponsors for funding approval.

* Capture process metrics and prepare the Process Qualification / Assessment output, including pipeline prioritisation where multiple candidates compete for the same delivery capacity.

* Use Process Mining and Task Mining outputs where available to validate stated process behaviour against actual system event data, rather than relying solely on stakeholder recall.

* Conduct deep-dive "As-Is" analysis to design optimized "To-Be" states, ensuring processes are not just automated, but architected for peak efficiency.

* Author comprehensive Process Design Documents (PDDs) and partner on Solution Designs (SDDs) to ensure absolute logic clarity and traceability.

* Produce end-to-end process maps and flow diagrams (BPMN / Visio / Lucid), covering the happy path, every business exception, every system exception and the defined handling for each.

* Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it.

* Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model.

* As-Is and To-Be process maps and detailed process flow diagrams.

* Process Definition Document (PDD) and contribution to the Solution Design Document (SDD).

* Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules.

* Migration Fluency: Specific exposure to UiPath and/or Blue Prism.

* Demonstrated end-to-end SDLC ownership: evidence of personally carrying at least three automation or AI initiatives from discovery through production deployment and hypercare, not only the documentation phase.

 

**Strong Plus:**

 

* UiPath Certified Professional Business Analyst (UiBPA).

The Global Business Process Expert (BPX) is accountable for designing, standardizing, and evolving the end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) event-driven operating model. This role plays a critical part in a multi-year transformation to shift from traditional order entry to a proactive, exception-based customer service model enabled by automation, advanced workflows, and AI-driven insights.
  
  
The Global BPE partners closely with the Global Process Owner to define new ways of working that fundamentally change how work is performed, introducing event orchestration, touchless order processing, and real-time intervention capabilities. This includes designing global standards, governance frameworks, and scalable process models that drive consistency across regions while improving service reliability, speed, and cost efficiency.
  
  
To ensure these standards remain relevant and effective, the Global BPX actively incorporates feedback from Regional BPXs into the evolution of global standards. This role combines process design, transformation execution, and technology enablement, ensuring that future-state processes are not only well-defined but also practical, scalable, and aligned to business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Global Process Design & Transformation**

* Design and document future-state O2C processes, emphasizing event-driven orchestration and exception-based execution.
* Embed new ways of working that shift teams from transactional processing to proactive event management.
* Set global standards for touchless order processing, intelligent exception handling, and consistent customer outcomes.

**Event & Exception Framework**

* Develop and maintain a global event taxonomy (e.g., order failures, credit blocks, supply and delivery risks).
* Define event triggers, thresholds, prioritization logic, and escalation paths to enable timely intervention.
* Create standardized response playbooks to ensure consistent issue handling and resolution across regions.

**Technology & Digital Enablement**

* Analyze cross-regional performance trends to identify systemic issues, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase automation, reduce manual effort, and improve service reliability.

**Change & Adoption Support**

* Support development of training materials, playbooks, and communications to enable adoption of new processes and tools.
* Partner with regional teams to drive readiness, deployment, and sustained adoption of standardized ways of working.
* Reinforce a culture of standardization, accountability, and continuous improvement across the O2C community.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or a related field.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.
* Ability to drive global standardization and harmonization.
* Analytical mindset with expertise in continuous improvement methodologies.
